escalation: Monthly base rent increases by $300.00 on the second anniversary of the Commencement Date and by an additional $300.00 on each anniversary thereafter for the remainder of the term
cam: Tenant shall contribute toward shared building costs in a manner and amount to be reasonably determined by the Landlord from time to time, consistent with practices at comparable properties in the vicinity
renewal_option: Single option to extend for one additional period of five years, exercisable by written notice given at a commercially reasonable time prior to expiration of the initial term, provided Tenant is not in default
uncertainty_notes: CAM contribution amount and determination method are vague ('reasonably determined by Landlord from time to time'). Renewal option notice timing is unclear ('commercially reasonable time' is not defined with specific days/months). Human review recommended for both provisions.
